title: 第28章 秦时古篆，天书之谜
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
“顾长青……”

    林薇的脑子里“嗡”的一声，被重锤狠狠砸了一下。

    这个名字，她太熟悉了。

    不是从什么正史里，而是从一份被列为最高机密的考古档案里。

    秦始皇陵，兵马俑，一号坑，角落里发现的一卷残破竹简。

    当年因为技术限制和内容过于惊世骇俗，解读工作被紧急叫停，所有资料全部封存。

    林薇作为“开拓者”计划的总指挥，有权限查阅这份档案。

    她清楚地记得，那份残破的解读报告上，用红笔圈出来的几个字——“长青”、“金丹”、“大道”。

    当时，她和所有看到这份报告的人一样，都觉得这不过是两千多年前，某个方士喝多了写的胡话。

    可现在，当“顾长青”这个名字，和“长生”这两个字，清清楚楚地出现在这口疑似汉代王爷的玉棺上时，一切都变了。

    一个荒诞到让她头皮发麻的念头，不受控制地从心底里冒了出来。

    难道……

    那些神话传说，是真的？

    “林队！林队！你没事吧？”

    通讯器里传来队员焦急的呼喊。

    林薇猛地回过神，她深吸一口气，强迫自己混乱的大脑重新运转起来。

    “我没事。”

    她的声音有些干涩，“所有单位注意，保持警戒，不要靠近玉棺！”

    她知道，自己可能触碰到了一扇通往全新世界的大门，但这扇门背后，是机遇，还是万劫不复的深渊，谁也说不准。

    此刻，演播厅里，也已经彻底炸开了锅。

    “顾长青！真的是顾长青！”

    张建国教授激动地站了起来，双手撑着桌子，身体因为过度激动而微微颤抖，“我就说！我就说《史记》里对这个人的记载太过简略，语焉不详，其中必有隐情！一个能被始皇帝拜为上卿，总领灭六国方略的人，怎么可能在史书上只留下几笔？原来……原来秘密在这里！”

    “秦朝的上卿，汉朝的王陵……”

    主持人冰冰感觉自己的CPU也快烧了，“张老，这……这到底是怎么回事？难道这座地宫，根本不是淮南王刘安的，而是那个大秦上卿顾长青的？”

    “很有可能！”
content_en:
"Gu Changqing..."

    There was a "buzz" in Lin Wei's head, and she was hit hard by a heavy hammer.

    This name was too familiar to her.

    Not from any official history, but from an archaeological file classified as top secret.

    Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum, Terracotta Warriors and Horses, Pit No. 1, and a broken bamboo slip found in the corner.

    At that time, due to technical limitations and the shocking content, the interpretation work was urgently stopped and all the materials were sealed.

    As the commander-in-chief of the "Pioneer" project, Lin Wei has the authority to access this file.

    She clearly remembered the words "Evergreen", "Golden Pill" and "Dao" circled in red pen on the broken interpretation report.

    At that time, she, like everyone who saw the report, felt that it was just nonsense written by a certain alchemist who drank too much more than two thousand years ago.

    But now, when the name "Gu Changqing" and the words "Eternal Life" clearly appeared on this jade coffin that was suspected to be a prince of the Han Dynasty, everything changed.

    An idea so absurd that it made her scalp tingle came out of her heart uncontrollably.

    Could it be...

    Are those myths and legends true?

    "Captain Lin! Captain Lin! Are you okay?"

    The anxious shouts of the team members came from the communicator.

    Lin Wei suddenly came back to her senses. She took a deep breath and forced her confused brain to start functioning again.

    "I'm fine."

    Her voice was a little dry, "Attention all units, stay alert and don't get close to the jade coffin!"

    She knew that she might have touched a door to a whole new world, but no one could tell whether there was an opportunity or an abyss of destruction behind this door.

    At this moment, the studio had completely exploded.

    "Gu Changqing! It's really Gu Changqing!"

    Professor Zhang Jianguo stood up excitedly, holding his hands on the table, his body trembling slightly due to excessive excitement, "I'm just saying! I'm just saying that the record of this man in "Historical Records" is too brief and unclear. There must be a hidden secret! How could a person who was worshiped as a minister by the First Emperor and led the strategy of destroying six countries leave only a few strokes in the history books? It turns out...it turns out that the secret is here!"

    "The Shangqing of the Qin Dynasty, the royal tombs of the Han Dynasty..."

    The host Bingbing felt that her CPU was about to burn out, "Mr. Zhang, what on earth is going on? Could it be that this underground palace does not belong to Huainan King Liu An at all, but to that Great Qin Shangqing Gu Changqing?"

    "It's very possible!"
title_en: Chapter 28 The Ancient Seal Script of the Qin Dynasty and the Mystery of the Book of Heaven
